macros.name: attach
macros.doc: You may add an embedded file to the global attachments array using \attach[⟨name⟩].

macros.name: DDDcontext
macros.doc: For annotation with ⟨name⟩ the context is made available in \DDDcontext{⟨name⟩}.

macros.name: DDDview
macros.doc: \DDDview[⟨view name⟩][⟨key-value parameters⟩] is the command for defining 3D views.

macros.name: DDDview
macros.doc: \DDDview[⟨view name⟩][⟨key-value parameters⟩] is the command for defining 3D views.

macros.name: duplexdisplay
macros.doc: You can request two page view (odd pages on the right) using \duplexdisplay.

macros.name: lininglinks
macros.doc: \lininglinks sets the dimensions for running text – it covers all space of a line using \baselineskip.

macros.name: nolininglinks
macros.doc: If you want to define big clickable buttons, you may need to turn off the lining effect using \nolininglinks.

macros.name: pageduration
macros.doc: Page durations can be set either using \defaultpageduration[⟨duration⟩] or \pageduration[⟨duration⟩], where duration is in seconds (default is no auto advancement, i.e. ∞).

macros.name: pageduration

macros.name: pdfaction
macros.doc: \pdfaction[⟨action spec⟩] is available for lower level creation of different actions, but for clickable areas on page you will use \hlink[⟨action spec⟩]{⟨text⟩} with a very similiar syntax.

macros.name: render
macros.doc: Use command \render[⟨name⟩][⟨optional key-value parameters⟩]{⟨appearance⟩} for inserting audio/video with Renditions or \RM[⟨name⟩][⟨optional key-value parameters⟩]{⟨appearance⟩} for inserting audio/video/3D as Rich Media annnotation.

macros.name: render

macros.name: renditionautoplay
macros.doc: \renditionautoplay is defined as a shorthand for action to play the lastly defined rendition on page visible event.

macros.name: transition
macros.doc: \transition[⟨transition spec⟩] sets transition for the “current page”, \transitions sets the default.
